title: Missing benchmark for HNSW performance at scale
description:
> CONTEXT BLOCK:

**File/Function:** `doc_transformer/benches/graph_bench.rs` (does not exist)

**The Smell:** No performance benchmarks exist to validate O(n log n) claim. Need criterion benchmark to prove scaling.

> SPECIFICATION BLOCK:

## EARS:
- When running benchmarks, the system shall measure build_knowledge_dag time for N = [100, 1K, 5K, 10K, 20K]
- When N doubles, the system shall show time increases by < 2.5x (proving sub-quadratic)
- When displaying results, the system shall show edges/second metric

## DbC:
**Preconditions:**
- criterion is in dev-dependencies
- Test data generator exists
**Postconditions:**
- Benchmark runs without OOM
- Results stored in target/criterion
- Performance regression detectable

## Benchmark Setup:
```toml
# Cargo.toml
[dev-dependencies]
criterion = "0.5"

[[bench]]
name = "graph_bench"
harness = false
```

```rust
// benches/graph_bench.rs
use criterion::{criterion_group, criterion_main, Criterion};

fn bench_dag_build(c: &mut Criterion) {
    for n in [100, 1000, 5000, 10000] {
        c.bench_function(&format!("dag_build_{}", n), |b| {
            let chunks = generate_test_chunks(n);
            b.iter(|| build_knowledge_dag(&docs, &chunks, &tags));
        });
    }
}
```

**Expected Results:**
- 1,000 chunks: < 1 second
- 5,000 chunks: < 5 seconds  
- 10,000 chunks: < 15 seconds
- 20,000 chunks: < 45 seconds

dependencies.title: Refactor build_knowledge_dag to use HNSW instead of O(n²) loop
dependencies.description:
> CONTEXT BLOCK:

**File/Function:** `doc_transformer/src/index.rs:329-374` (function `build_knowledge_dag`)

**The Smell:** Nested O(n²) loop compares every chunk against every other chunk. Must be replaced with single HNSW index build + O(n log n) queries.

> SPECIFICATION BLOCK:

## EARS:
- When building DAG, the system shall create HnswSimilarityIndex ONCE before chunk loop
- When processing each chunk, the system shall query HNSW for top-K neighbors (not all chunks)
- When adding edges, the system shall only add K edges per chunk (configurable, default=20)
- When HNSW query fails, the system shall log warning and continue (no crash)

## DbC:
**Preconditions:**
- HnswSimilarityIndex::build succeeds
- max_related_chunks config is loaded
- Chunks have valid tags
**Postconditions:**
- Total related edges ≤ N × max_related_chunks
- No chunk compares against itself
- Complexity is O(n log n) not O(n²)
**Invariants:**
- Each chunk has ≤ max_related_chunks related edges
- DAG property maintained (no cycles)

## Before (lines 329-374):
```rust
for (i, chunk) in chunks.iter().enumerate() {
    let all_chunks_metadata: Vec<_> = chunks.iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(j, _)| j != &i)  // O(n) for each chunk!
        .map(...)
        .collect();
    
    let related = detector.detect_relationships(..., &all_chunks_metadata);
    for (related_id, weight) in related {
        dag.add_edge(...);  // Creates 1.4M edges!
    }
}
```

## After:
```rust
let similarity_index = HnswSimilarityIndex::build(&document_tags, hnsw_m, hnsw_ef)?;

for chunk in chunks.iter() {
    let related = similarity_index.find_similar(&chunk.chunk_id, max_related_chunks)?;
    for (related_id, weight) in related {
        dag.add_edge(...);  // Creates only K edges per chunk
    }
}
```

**Edge Cases:**
- HNSW build fails → fallback to top-K limiting (Option C)
- Empty chunks list → skip graph building
- Single chunk → no related edges
- All chunks have empty tags → no related edges
